name: nRF52840
description: Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840: an Arm Cortex-M4F at 64 MHz with 1 MiB of flash and 256 KiB of RAM, a 2.4 GHz multiprotocol radio (Bluetooth LE, 802.15.4), USB; the nRF52840 DK's MCU.

memory.name: code_ram
memory.doc: The same RAM on the code bus

sources.name: hfint
sources.doc: The 64 MHz internal oscillator: the core's clock until HFXO starts, and at the same speed after

sources.name: hse
sources.doc: HFXO: the board's 32 MHz crystal, multiplied to 64 MHz

sources.name: lfclk
sources.doc: LFCLK: the 32.768 kHz clock (LFXO, LFRC or synthesised), the RTCs' timebase

register_file.license: BSD-3-Clause (converted from Nordic Semiconductor's nrf52840.svd, Copyright (c) 2010 - 2024 Nordic Semiconductor ASA; LICENSES/BSD-3-Clause.txt)

functional.claims: Armv7E-M (Cortex-M4 with the single-precision FPU) execution by the Cortex-M core extracted from EmbCC; every register of nrf52840.svd with its reset value, shared address spaces as one peripheral; behavioural models of CLOCK (HFXO's debounce, LFCLK), the GPIO ports (direction, drive modes, pulls, SENSE, LATCH and DETECT), GPIOTE (event and task channels, PORT), UART0/UARTE0 and UARTE1 (the UART's RXD FIFO, EasyDMA buffers, SHORTS, frames at BAUDRATE's rate on their PSEL pins), TIMER0-4 (timer and counter modes, compares, shorts) and RTC0-2 (prescaled 24-bit counters, compares, overflow), extracted from EmbCC but GPIOTE; and, written for EmbSIM, SPIM0-3 (EasyDMA transfers in modes 0 to 3 at FREQUENCY's rates on their PSEL pins, ORC, END_START, SPIM3's CSN), TWIM0-1 (START, repeated START and STOP on open-drain SCL and SDA at 100, 250 or 400 kbps, EasyDMA buffers, LASTTX and LASTRX with their shorts, SUSPEND and RESUME, ERRORSRC's ANACK and DNACK), PWM0-3 (the four channels from EasyDMA sequences in the Common, Grouped, Individual and WaveForm decodings, Up and UpAndDown counting, REFRESH, ENDDELAY, LOOP and the shorts) and the SAADC (eight channels on AIN0-7, VDD and VDDH/5, single-ended and differential, the gains and references, 8 to 14 bits, oversampling and burst, the limits, scans into Data RAM at TACQ + 2 us a conversion, the local timer); FICR carries a part's factory words.
omissions: SPIS, TWIS, the legacy SPI and TWI, PDM, I2S, QDEC, COMP (plain registers)
SPIM's and TWIM's EasyDMA lists, clock stretching by an I2C slave, arbitration; the SAADC's resistor ladders, its load on the circuit, noise and offset and gain errors

timed.claims: Instruction timing estimated from EmbCC's Cortex-M4 cost table (ADR-015); the core at 64 MHz; TIMERs at 16 MHz / 2^PRESCALER and RTCs at 32.768 kHz exactly against it.
omissions: flash wait states and the instruction cache

electrical.claims: GPIO pin-model defaults at 3.0 V from the product specification (standard drive, 13 k pulls).
